Game Overview

At its heart, Peckish Kappa is a arcade game about guide a clever Kappa through a series of mind-bending puzzles and obstacles to evade a relentless fox in this folklore-inspired adventure. With increasing difficulty, your challenge is to solve each puzzle while predicting the fox’s moves, using quick reflexes and strategic thinking to ensure survival.
